Overview

Trikala is a city in Thessaly with a population of 81,355. Thessalian city with a charming old town, the famous Lithaios River, and the Asclepius temple ruins. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
